data.title: Exploring Balance and Equality
data.description: Practice changing both sides of a balance scale and discover how to find the mystery quantity while keeping equations equal.

challenges.instruction: Find the mystery number that makes both sides balance.
challenges.hint: Remove the 5 block from both sides. What is left on each side?

challenges.hint: Remove the 6 block from both sides. What is left on each side?
